mintAuthority.summary: yBOLD deposits are BOLD-funded, but its fixed Yearn V3 implementation also issues accountant fee shares. Authorized removal from the RoleManager and acceptance by its fixed chad recipient exposes arbitrary role assignment and accountant replacement; repeated uncapped fee reports can dilute local shares. Base BOLD issuance remains inherited.

controls.label: Yearn yBOLD vault share accounting
controls.capDescription: Ordinary deposit/mint shares require BOLD and the fixed clone implementation cannot be replaced. This wrapper path does not create base BOLD; the separate mutable accountant authorization path is reviewed independently.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25573280, asset() returned BOLD 0x6440f144b7e50D6a8439336510312d2F54beB01D and apiVersion() returned 3.0.4. The yBOLD runtime was the 45-byte EIP-1167 minimal-proxy form with fixed implementation 0xd8063123bba3b480569244ae66bfe72b6c84b00d; that implementation had direct code and zero EIP-1967 implementation, admin, and beacon slots.

controls.label: Yearn yBOLD role-manager removal and accountant authorization
controls.capDescription: Current DADDY/BRAIN role masks exclude ACCOUNTANT_MANAGER, but BRAIN can removeVault and transfer the vault role-manager position to fixed chad. That recipient can accept, assign ACCOUNTANT_MANAGER and REPORTING_MANAGER, and install an accountant returning arbitrary fee amounts. The vault has no immutable fee ceiling; repeated reports can issue local fee shares without matching new BOLD.

controls.evidence: Source-scoped correction. At Ethereum block 26236749, hash 0x075b737aa6395c4c52dfa8e5e0665b1735fea7c97981efb726bc40a145247967, timestamp 2026-10-20T22:20:59Z, https://ethereum-rpc.publicnode.com pinned reads return role_manager 0xb3bd6b2e61753c311efbcf0111f75d29706d9a41, accountant 0x53acebb9470cfc9d231075154f5dcf1586a4c6fa and apiVersion 3.0.4. RoleManager getBrain is 0x16388463d60ffe0661cf7f1f31a7d658ac790ff7 with actual vault mask 14706; getDaddy and chad are 0xfeb4acf3df3cdea7399794d0869ef76a6efaff52 with actual mask 16374. Neither mask contains ACCOUNTANT_MANAGER. The verified RoleManager.removeVault BRAIN path nevertheless transfers role management to chad; the vault accept_role_manager and set_role paths then permit accountant/reporting authorization. _process_report accepts accountant-returned total_fees, computes fee shares and issues them to the accountant without a cumulative source-enforced fee ceiling. The currently installed accountant charges only actual gain and is not asserted malicious; mutability of its replacement path is the adverse fact, not a measured exploit. Header hash matched before and after all pinned reads; historical July observations are retained.

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25573280, yBOLD asset() returned the reviewed BOLD token and apiVersion() returned 3.0.4. The token is a 45-byte EIP-1167 clone fixed to Yearn V3 Vault implementation 0xd8063123bba3b480569244ae66bfe72b6c84b00d; the implementation's EIP-1967 implementation, admin, and beacon slots were zero. The original review stated shares were bounded by deposited BOLD; base BOLD supply cannot be created locally and no named prudential supervisor applies. Source-scoped correction (2026-10-20): immutable bytecode does not establish deposit-only share issuance. Exact implementation _process_report issues accountant fee shares. Current pinned block 26236749 establishes the mutable RoleManager removal-to-chad path described in the separate native minter-admin control; accepting role management permits arbitrary accountant/reporting roles and repeated local dilution without new BOLD. Current gain-only accountant behavior is not an immutable ceiling. Original July review start and pins are preserved; this is a source-supported authority correction, not an allegation of exploitation.
